description: Bus stops is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Open Data Bristol. Datagov. Coverage: Bristol. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
